description: Set fill, stroke, stroke width, dash, opacity or text colour on nodes, or move the icon on icon cards (iconPlacement). Pass at least one property. One undo step. A diagram regenerated from text drops these unless its DSL carries them (get_diagram lists them as canvasEdits).

documentId.description: File-mode document id from openflow_open or openflow_create; omit to use the paired editor (or, in file mode, the document opened or created last).

iconPlacement.description: Icon cards only: the icon above its caption (top) or left of its text (left). It resizes the card, so pass it on its own.

ids.description: Node ids to restyle (get_document lists them).

pageId.description: Page to act on (see list_pages); defaults to the page the editor shows, or the first page in file mode.

name: style
title: Style shapes
